SCHW Valuation Insights, FY ended 2025-12-31, with the latest quarter (three months ended 2026-09-30, filing 0000316709-26-000035). No calculations were performed by the model. Every computed figure below is a supplied calculation, labeled "computed, rechecked given calculations."

HEADLINE CONTEXT (EPS set aside until the financing and cash context is shown)
- Revenue growth, computed, rechecked given calculations: (23921000000 - 19606000000) / 19606000000 = 22.008568805467714%. Inputs: [XBRL tag Revenues, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009] = 23,921,000,000 and [XBRL tag Revenues, period end 2024-12-31, filing 0000316709-25-000010] = 19,606,000,000.
- Net income rose from 5,942,000,000 to 8,852,000,000 [XBRL tag NetIncomeLoss, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009; prior period end 2024-12-31, filing 0000316709-25-000010]. Diluted EPS was 4.65 versus 2.99 [XBRL tag EarningsPerShareDiluted, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009; prior period end 2024-12-31, filing 0000316709-25-000010]. No EPS growth rate was supplied. I have requested one below rather than computing it.

1) CASH GENERATION: MIXED (strong FY2025 level, but the prior-year base was low and the drivers are not explained in the supplied evidence)
- Operating cash flow was 9,311,000,000 [XBRL tag NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009]. The prior year was 2,670,000,000 [same tag, period end 2024-12-31, filing 0000316709-25-000010].
- Capital spending was 548,000,000 [XBRL tag PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009]. The prior year was 620,000,000 [same tag, period end 2024-12-31, filing 0000316709-25-000010].
- Free cash flow, computed, rechecked given calculations: 9311000000 - 548000000 = 8,763,000,000 USD. Inputs: the two FY2025 XBRL facts cited above.
- The filing confirms the operating figure: "Net cash inflows from operations during 2025 were $9.3 billion." [10-K.txt:L2957]. The same passage says investing cash inflows were $24.5 billion and "net financing outflows of $29.7 billion, primarily due to paydowns of FHLB borrowings and other short-term borrowings by a net total of $14.0 billion, repurchases of common and nonvoting common stock for $7.3 billion, and the redemption of Series G preferred stock for $2.5 billion." [10-K.txt:L2957].
- Why mixed: operating cash flow was 2,670,000,000 in 2024 [10-K.txt:L2958: "net cash inflows from operations totaled $2.7 billion"]. The supplied evidence does not explain the swing, so I do not treat the FY2025 level as a stable run-rate. The reported free cash flow was also absorbed by financing outflows, including buybacks and debt paydown.

2) PROFITABILITY: MIXED
- Operating margin: operating income is not available in the supplied XBRL data [operating_income tag null]. The supplied operating_margin formula is "None / 23921000000" with value null. The supplied missing-fact filing passages contain no operating income line, so operating margin is not established by the supplied evidence.
- Return on average equity, computed, rechecked given calculations: 8852000000 / ((49425000000 + 48375000000) / 2) = 18.102249488752555%. Definition as supplied: reported net income fact divided by the simple average of current and prior year-end stockholders' equity. Inputs: [XBRL tag NetIncomeLoss, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009]; [XBRL tag StockholdersEquity, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009] = 49,425,000,000; [XBRL tag StockholdersEquity, period end 2024-12-31, filing 0000316709-25-000010] = 48,375,000,000. Total stockholders' equity is the denominator, and the supplied measure does not deduct preferred stock.
- Latest quarter (three months ended 2026-09-30): GAAP diluted EPS was 1.62 [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L128-L131, quote: "Diluted earnings per common share\nGAAP\n$\n1.62"]. The adjusted figure was 1.69, which "Excluding $151 million of pre-tax transaction-related costs" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L14]. Adjusted EPS is non-GAAP, so I rely on the GAAP figure.
- Quarterly revenue growth, computed, rechecked given calculations: (7171.0 - 6135.0) / 6135.0 * 100 = 16.88671556642217%. Inputs: [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L96, quote "7,171"] and [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L98, quote "6,135"].
- The release also shows a quarterly GAAP pre-tax profit margin of 52.7% [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L151-L154] and an annualized GAAP return on average common stockholders' equity of 25% [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L2838-L2840]. These are release definitions and not the operating margin or ROAE definition above. They are not comparable to the 18.10% annual figure and are not used to fill the missing operating margin.

3) FUNDING RISK: MIXED
- Debt to equity, computed, rechecked given calculations: (22199000000) / 49425000000 = 0.44914516944865956 ratio. Inputs: [XBRL tag LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsIncludingCurrentMaturities, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009] = 22,199,000,000 (prior year 22,428,000,000 at period end 2024-12-31, filing 0000316709-25-000010); [XBRL tag StockholdersEquity, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009] = 49,425,000,000.
- Debt components included: only long-term debt with the current portion included once. As supplied, it "excludes repos, secured financings, and lease liabilities not included in the selected XBRL debt tags."
- Missing XBRL values: current_portion_of_long_term_debt and short_term_borrowings are "not available in the supplied XBRL data." That does not mean the filing omits them, so I checked the supplied filing passages.
- The filing discloses other short-term borrowings: "Total other short-term borrowings outstanding at December 31, 2025 and 2024 were $ 6.9 billion and $" [10-K.txt:L7962-L7964, with "6.9" at L7963]. The balance sheet lines read "Other short-term borrowings" 6,913 and 5,999 [10-K.txt:L4091-L4093]. These are excluded from the 0.449 ratio. I do not treat them as zero or as included.
- The maturity table lists FHLB borrowings of 1,850 and other short-term borrowings of 6,913 for 2026 [10-K.txt:L8007-L8013].
- Securities lending is a further funding source outside the ratio: "liabilities for securities loaned totaled $25.1 billion and are included in payables to brokers, dealers, and clearing organizations" [10-K.txt:L2954].
- Direction of risk: the Q2 2026 release note says there were "incremental capital expenditures of $633 million related to a multi-year software license agreement with a corresponding liability recognized in long-term debt." [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L1014]. The FY2025 debt ratio therefore likely understates later long-term debt. The supplied evidence does not give the updated balance.
- Why mixed: the supplied ratio of 0.449 is moderate, but it covers only part of the funding stack. A fuller leverage measure is not established by the supplied evidence, so I request it below.

4) VALUATION: UNSUPPORTED
- P/E, computed, rechecked given calculations: 93.37 / 4.65 = 20.079569892473117 ratio. Price source: user-supplied --price, run time 2026-11-05T09:29:15-05:00; the market quote timestamp was not provided. EPS input: [XBRL tag EarningsPerShareDiluted, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009] = 4.65.
- Comparability limits: the price is from November 2026 but the earnings are FY2025 diluted EPS, so the multiple mixes periods. Newer GAAP quarterly EPS was 1.62 for the three months ended 2026-09-30 [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L128-L131], and no trailing-four-quarter EPS was supplied.
- Peers: the supplied peer data is empty (peers: {}). A peer P/E comparison is not established by the supplied evidence, so the 20.08x multiple cannot be judged as cheap or expensive.

WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY VIEW
- Measure: net cash provided by operating activities. The current value is 9,311,000,000 [XBRL tag NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities, period end 2025-12-31, filing 0000316709-26-000009]. If the next reported annual figure falls back toward the 2024 level of 2,670,000,000 [same tag, period end 2024-12-31, filing 0000316709-25-000010], I would downgrade cash generation to unsupported. If it stays near or above 9,311,000,000 with comparable capital spending, I would upgrade it to supported.

Insight: The 20.08x P/E rests on a mismatch, a user-supplied 93.37 price with no quote timestamp (run time 2026-11-05) against FY2025 diluted EPS of 4.65, and no peer figures were supplied to anchor it.
